name: Web Validator by DigestSEO
tagline: Validate HTML, CSS, technical SEO, JSON-LD, links, and responsive screenshots
description: A local stdio MCP server for developer-facing web quality checks. Validate HTML and CSS, inspect technical SEO and accessibility signals, check JSON-LD syntax and public links, produce combined reports, and capture responsive screenshots for user-authorized pages or local files.

install.notes: Requires Node.js 22.12 or newer. No API key is required for the local stdio server.
